name: Game rules
note: Each bundle lists its game rules with their types and defaults (55 for 1.21.8, 52 for 1.21.4, and the experimental minecartMaxSpeed). Rules are world state: a logged command sets them within the official bounds, checkpoints keep them, and /gamerule queries and sets them with the official replies
deviations: only randomTickSpeed (random ticks) and spawnChunkRadius (the spawn chunks) have behavior; the other rules are kept but change nothing
